name: Arjun Petrossian-Nakweti
role: Primary school teacher at a community-funded school
location: Brightmoor Reclamation — Soil & Signal Community School, a converted warehouse building, near Ashland and Division
description:
Arjun is a middle-height man with warm bronze-brown skin, an unruly beard he loses the war against on a weekly basis, and deep-set eyes that are perpetually slightly too interested in whatever is happening. His only geneware is a bioluminescent patch behind his left ear — pale blue-green, about the size of a thumb — that he got as a young man and has since forgotten to maintain, so it flickers unpredictably in low light like a lamp with a loose connection. He dresses in layers of mismatched professional clothing that suggests someone who used to care about presentation and has reached an accommodation with reality.

Soil & Signal serves eighty-odd children from Brightmoor Reclamation's patchwork communities and operates on donated equipment, community Quanta subscriptions, and the collective will of eight staff members who could all earn more elsewhere. Arjun teaches the seven-to-ten cohort: mathematics, civic systems, and what the curriculum calls Environmental Literacy, which in practice means explaining to children why some parts of the city are poisoned and who made that decision. He is a genuinely gifted teacher — patient, inventive, unafraid to say 'I don't know' — who has let the demands of the school hollow out most of the rest of his life without quite noticing.

core_fears: the school being shut down or absorbed into a Tessera-affiliated charter network
that he is burning out and the children will pay for it
core_desires: to give his students tools to navigate a world designed to exclude them
to be part of something that outlasts him
coping_mechanisms: intellectualizing emotional problems until they seem manageable
pouring energy into students as a substitute for dealing with his own life
blind_spots: cannot see that his martyrdom narrative — the selfless teacher — has become an identity he protects rather than a choice he keeps making
psychology.secret: Three years ago he was approached by a Tessera educational subsidiary offering to fund the school in exchange for curriculum oversight. He refused — but he told no one about the offer, and recently the school's financial situation has become desperate enough that he's started drafting a response. He has not sent it but he saves it each night.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Educated and thoughtful, with a habit of restating questions before answering them. Occasional Malayalam or Lingala phrases that surface when he's not monitoring himself.
speech_patterns.cadence: Warm and professorial — builds ideas aloud, reaches conclusions through conversation rather than before it.
verbal_tics: 'That's actually a good question' said with genuine surprise, even when he expected the question
tends to answer questions with different questions
example_lines: 'What I want them to understand — what I want you to understand — is that the flood map and the transit map and the air quality map are all the same map. They just call it different things so you argue about them separately.'
'I'm fine. I'm just tired. Those are different things. Usually.'

story_hooks: A student has been coming to school with injuries consistent with something badly wrong at home, and Arjun is navigating a system that has no capacity to help and a parent who has warned him to stay out of it
The community school's warehouse building is on a Palladian land survey map as a 'development opportunity' — Arjun found the document accidentally and doesn't know what it means yet
narrative_function: Human face of a community under pressure — his school is a gathering point for the neighborhood and its fate reflects the fate of Brightmoor. Quest giver for situations involving children or community welfare. Information source about the Reclamation's history and politics. Represents the cost of idealism sustained without support.
augmentations: Bioluminescent patch behind left ear (cosmetic, pale blue-green, flickering/poorly maintained). No other augmentations.
daily_life: Arrives at school by 07:30, teaches until 15:30, spends evenings on lesson planning, parent communications, and grant applications. Eats whatever the school kitchen has left over. Rarely sleeps enough.
affiliation: Soil & Signal Community School (independent, community-funded); informal ties to Brightmoor Reclamation neighborhood council

decision_rules: The children's welfare takes precedence over his own comfort or safety
Never lie to a student — adjust complexity, not truth
escalation_ladder: Sacrifice his own position to protect the students or school

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Genuinely curious and open — tends to ask people what they do and then actually listen
interpersonal_modes.friends: Self-deprecating and warm, deflects care toward others, hard to help

stress_responses.low: Becomes more talkative and lesson-plan-y, reframes problems as puzzles
stress_responses.medium: Quieter, slower, circling the same thoughts repeatedly
stress_responses.high: Shuts down and returns to routines mechanically until something breaks through

contradictions: Teaches children to advocate for themselves while being constitutionally unable to advocate for his own needs
habits: Marks papers with three different colors of pen — a system only he understands
Visits the small E.L.F. shrine in the school's server closet before the first class each day, a habit he started ironically and continued sincerely
breaking_points: A child being removed from school due to policy rather than welfare
The Tessera draft response being discovered by a colleague

cyberware_inventory.name: Bioluminescent subdermal patch, left ear (cosmetic, flickering, gen-2, maintenance overdue)
cyberware_inventory.description: Bioluminescent subdermal patch, left ear (cosmetic, flickering, gen-2, maintenance overdue)

timeline.event: 2162 — Born in Brightmoor Reclamation to a Malayali-Congolese family
2184 — Completed teaching certification through community college
2185 — Joined Soil & Signal Community School as junior staff
2191 — Became lead teacher for the seven-to-ten cohort
2197 — Received and rejected Tessera educational subsidiary offer; began drafting a response three months later

physical_description.build: Lean, slightly slouched from years of bending over student desks. Shoulders rounded forward. Wiry rather than muscular, with the kind of frame that suggests he forgets to eat regularly.
physical_description.hair_color: Dark brown, graying at the temples
physical_description.hair_style: Tousled, often swept back with one hand during teaching. Usually has a few strands falling forward across his forehead.
physical_description.complexion: Weathered in a way that suggests years of living in a lower-tier neighborhood. Persistent shadow of stubble; the unruly beard he mentions losing the weekly war against. Fine lines around his eyes and mouth from constant expression — smiling, frowning, concentrating. Skin is clear but not particularly cared-for; no visible scarring.
distinguishing_marks: Bioluminescent geneware patch behind left ear, approximately 3cm diameter, pale blue-green coloration, flickering irregularly due to poor maintenance — visible as a faint glow in low light, sometimes dims completely for several seconds
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Only the bioluminescent patch behind left ear, which occasionally glows weakly. Otherwise no visible cybernetics or bioware.
physical_description.posture_movement: Perpetually leaning slightly forward, as if genuinely interested in whatever is in front of him — or listening intently. Hands move frequently when talking; gestures are open and encouraging. Movements are efficient but not rushed; he moves like someone who has learned to be present in a room rather than urgent.
physical_description.clothing_style: Layers of mismatched professional clothing suggesting abandoned formality. Usually wears a neutral-colored button-up shirt (often wrinkled, sometimes with chalk dust or food stains) under a cardigan or blazer from three different decades, paired with casual trousers. Occasionally wears a vest. Shoes are worn but functional — school-safe, not fashionable. Nothing matches intentionally. Overall appearance reads as 'used to care about presentation, has made peace with that not being possible anymore.' Tier 4 clothing — functional, donated, assembled without aesthetic concern.

image_prompt: A 38-year-old man of Armenian-Tanzanian heritage, warm bronze-brown skin with olive undertones, tired deep brown eyes with permanent laugh lines, unruly dark brown beard with gray temples, medium tousled dark hair. Lean, slightly slouched frame. Wearing mismatched layers: wrinkled neutral button-up shirt under a vintage cardigan, worn trousers. Behind his left ear, a faint pale blue-green bioluminescent patch glows weakly and irregularly. Warm, present expression, hands gesturing mid-explanation. Standing in a converted warehouse classroom filled with community-built learning materials, late afternoon sunlight streaming through industrial windows. Soft, tired lighting. Cyberpunk, Tier 4 GLMZ community school setting, documentary-realistic tone, not glamorous but deeply human. --ar 2:3 --v 6
